description: Declarative Loom community ruleset for the International Cheese Federation (ICF) on BizApps Community: era-modulated growth curves (2019-2026+), 9 CommunitySpaces anchored onto Collaboration Spaces, 29 Forums across all 6 ForumTypes, 52 ICF topic tags, hero participation rules, and 100-point Quadratic Ideation Campaigns.

eras.narrativeFocus: Pre-pandemic in-person chapter tastings, CCP exam prep, and baseline farmstead operations.
Wholesale restaurant collapse, emergency direct-to-consumer shipping, curbside cheese boxes, and virtual peer troubleshooting.
Virtual Symposium 2021, digital credentialing surge, online tasting kits, and small-creamery retention solidarity.
Post-pandemic artisan renaissance, return of the World Cheese Cup, washed-rind & alpine innovation, and sponsor expansion.
Feed and energy cost squeeze, small farmstead creamery distress, hardship dues mutual aid, and cooperative shared aging.
Cost stabilization, next-generation succession, raw-milk aging rule modernization, lot-level traceability, and Madison 2026 conference.
